name: cloudish
description: Deploy and operate containerized apps with Hal9 Cloudish from ChatGPT and Codex, each at an unlisted share link.

interface.longDescription: Cloudish by Hal9 helps coding agents prepare and deploy containerized websites, APIs, dashboards, and services. The plugin guides project inspection, Dockerfile preparation, runtime ports, persistent storage, encrypted secrets, deployment status, and troubleshooting using Cloudish's current API documentation. Cloudish builds containers server-side and returns an unlisted share link with a random, unguessable hostname, not a listed public address. The plugin contains deployment instructions; it does not include a connected MCP server or interactive app.

publication.release_notes: SKILL.md now describes each deployment as an unlisted share link with a random 128-bit hostname, not a listed public address, with a memorable custom subdomain as an opt-in, guessable choice; claiming a key also puts every project it deployed under the claimer's account. The documents otherwise match cloudish.ai: source attribution, runtimeClass sandbox hints, mint tokens, and claim bonuses.

review.commerce_description: Cloudish provides starter credits when available. Users may optionally buy prepaid hosting credits on Cloudish outside ChatGPT; no purchase is required to begin.
